insert-page-range-into-pdf.title: Insert Page Range from Source PDF into Destination PDF
insert-page-range-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert a specific range of pages from one PDF file into another using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor.

insert-page-range-into-pdf__v2.title: Insert Page Range from One PDF into Another Using Streams
insert-page-range-into-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to insert a specific range of pages from a source PDF stream into a destination PDF stream and write the merged document to an output stream with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

insert-selected-pages-into-pdf.title: Insert Selected Pages from One PDF into Another
insert-selected-pages-into-pdf.description: Shows how to insert specific pages from a source PDF into a destination PDF at a defined position using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.

insert-specific-pages-into-pdf.title: Insert Specific Pages from One PDF into Another Using Streams
insert-specific-pages-into-pdf.description: Shows how to insert selected pages from a source PDF into a destination PDF at a specified position using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor with input and output streams.

insert-pdf-pages-at-beginning.title: Insert PDF Pages at Beginning Using PdfFileEditor
insert-pdf-pages-at-beginning.description: Shows how to insert all pages from a source PDF at the start of another PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.

insert-pages-into-middle-of-pdf.title: Insert Pages from One PDF into the Middle of Another
insert-pages-into-middle-of-pdf.description: Shows how to insert all pages of a source PDF into the middle of a destination PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor.

append-pages-to-pdf.title: Append Pages from One PDF to Another
append-pages-to-pdf.description: Shows how to append all pages of a source PDF to the end of a destination PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor.

insert-pages-into-pdf-in-memory.title: Insert Pages from One PDF into Another In-Memory
insert-pages-into-pdf-in-memory.description: Shows how to create source and destination PDFs entirely in memory, then insert a specific page from the source PDF into the destination PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.Insert, and output the merged document to a MemoryStream.

batch-insert-page-ranges.title: Batch Insert Page Ranges from Multiple PDFs
batch-insert-page-ranges.description: Shows how to insert selected pages from several source PDFs into a single destination PDF in a loop, updating the insert position after each operation.

append-pages-from-multiple-pdfs.title: Append Pages from Multiple PDFs to a Base PDF
append-pages-from-multiple-pdfs.description: Demonstrates inserting a specific page range from several source PDFs into a base PDF in a single operation using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.TryAppend.

load-pdf-and-save-with-aspose-pdf.title: Load PDF and Save with Aspose.Pdf
load-pdf-and-save-with-aspose-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF file using Aspose.Pdf's Document class, checking its existence, and saving it to a new location.

load-pdf-and-save-copy.title: Load PDF and Save a Copy using Aspose.Pdf
load-pdf-and-save-copy.description: Shows how to load a PDF file from a file path with Aspose.Pdf's Document class and save it to another location.

insert-pages-into-pdf-and-save.title: Insert Pages into PDF and Save to File
insert-pages-into-pdf-and-save.description: Demonstrates how to insert selected pages from one PDF into another at a specific position using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and save the modified document to a new file.

rotate-pdf-page-save-to-memorystream.title: Rotate PDF Page and Save to MemoryStream
rotate-pdf-page-save-to-memorystream.description: Loads a PDF, rotates the first page 90 degrees clockwise, and saves the modified document directly into a MemoryStream without writing to disk.

split-pdf-from-first-to-end-page.title: Split PDF from First Page to Specified End Page
split-pdf-from-first-to-end-page.description: Demonstrates how to split a PDF starting at the first page up to a given page number using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and save the result to a new file.

split-pdf-from-first-page-to-end-page.title: Split PDF from First Page to Specified End Page Using Streams
split-pdf-from-first-page-to-end-page.description: Demonstrates how to split the first N pages of a PDF into a new document using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor with in‑memory streams.

split-pdf-into-bulk-page-sets.title: Split PDF into Bulk Page Sets with Aspose.PdfFileEditor
split-pdf-into-bulk-page-sets.description: Demonstrates how to split a PDF into multiple bulk page ranges using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor facade, including placeholder PDF creation and saving each bulk as a separate file.

split-pdf-into-bulk-page-sets__v2.title: Split PDF into Bulk Page Sets Using Streams
split-pdf-into-bulk-page-sets__v2.description: Shows how to split a PDF into defined page ranges (bulks) with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor and obtain each bulk as a MemoryStream.

split-pdf-from-page-to-end.title: Split PDF from Specific Page to End
split-pdf-from-page-to-end.description: Shows how to split a PDF starting at a given page number and save the resulting document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

split-pdf-from-start-to-end.title: Split PDF from Start Page to End Using MemoryStream
split-pdf-from-start-to-end.description: Shows how to extract the portion of a PDF starting at a given page through the end of the document and return it as a MemoryStream using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

split-pdf-into-individual-pages.title: Split PDF into Individual Page PDFs
split-pdf-into-individual-pages.description: Demonstrates how to split a PDF file into separate one‑page PDF documents using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor and save them to a specified output folder.

split-pdf-into-individual-page-pdfs.title: Split PDF into Individual Page PDFs Using Streams
split-pdf-into-individual-page-pdfs.description: Shows how to split a PDF into separate one‑page PDF files by reading the source as a stream, using PdfFileEditor.SplitToPages to get MemoryStreams for each page, and writing each stream to a file.

split-pdf-into-single-page-pdfs.title: Split PDF into Single‑Page PDFs Using MemoryStream
split-pdf-into-single-page-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to split a PDF into individual page PDFs using Aspose.Pdf's bulk split, iterating the returned MemoryStream array, and saving each stream to a uniquely named file.

concatenate-split-pdfs.title: Concatenate Split PDFs into a Single Document
concatenate-split-pdfs.description: Shows how to merge a series of split PDF files into one PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor.Insert method, with page counting and temporary file handling.

extract-front-part-pdf-splitfromfirst.title: Extract Front Part of PDF with SplitFromFirst
extract-front-part-pdf-splitfromfirst.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitFromFirst to extract pages from the beginning of a PDF up to a specified page and save them as a new document.

extract-front-pages-splitfromfirst-strea.title: Extract Front Pages from PDF Using SplitFromFirst with Streams
extract-front-pages-splitfromfirst-strea.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitFromFirst with in‑memory streams to extract pages 1 through a specified end page from a PDF.

split-pdf-into-multiple-page-ranges.title: Split PDF into Multiple Page Ranges Using PdfFileEditor
split-pdf-into-multiple-page-ranges.description: Demonstrates how to split a PDF into separate documents based on defined page ranges with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitToBulks and save each part as a PDF file.

split-pdf-into-multiple-bulks.title: Split PDF into Multiple Bulks Using Streams
split-pdf-into-multiple-bulks.description: Shows how to split a PDF into defined page ranges (bulks) with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitToBulks and process the resulting MemoryStream objects.

split-pdf-from-start-page-to-end.title: Split PDF from a Start Page to the End
split-pdf-from-start-page-to-end.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitToEnd to extract pages from a specified start page through the end of a PDF and save them as a new file.

split-pdf-from-start-page-to-end-using-s.title: Split PDF from a Start Page to End Using Streams
split-pdf-from-start-page-to-end-using-s.description: Demonstrates how to split a PDF from a specified start page to the end of the document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor with input and output streams.

split-pdf-into-individual-pages__v2.title: Split PDF into Individual Pages Using PdfFileEditor
split-pdf-into-individual-pages__v2.description: Demonstrates how to split a multi‑page PDF into separate one‑page PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.SplitToPages.

split-pdf-into-page-streams.title: Split PDF into Individual Page Streams
split-pdf-into-page-streams.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor to split a PDF into separate MemoryStream objects, each containing a single page, and optionally write them to files.

delete-pages-from-pdf-file-path.title: Delete Pages 2‑5 from PDF Using File‑Path Overload
delete-pages-from-pdf-file-path.description: Demonstrates how to remove specific pages (2‑5) from a PDF file by using the PdfFileEditor.Delete method that works with input and output file paths.

delete-specific-pages-from-pdf.title: Delete Specific Pages from PDF using PdfFileEditor
delete-specific-pages-from-pdf.description: Shows how to remove selected pages from a PDF by passing input and output streams to Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.

remove-first-and-last-pages-from-pdf.title: Remove First and Last Pages from PDF
remove-first-and-last-pages-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to delete the first and last pages of a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor.Delete method with a page number array.

batch-delete-pages-from-multiple-pdfs.title: Batch Delete Pages from Multiple PDFs
batch-delete-pages-from-multiple-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to loop through PDF files in a folder and delete specific pages from each using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.

validate-pdf-page-deletion.title: Validate PDF Page Deletion Reduces Page Count
validate-pdf-page-deletion.description: Shows how to delete specific pages from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and verify that the total page count decreases after the operation.

concatenate-three-pdfs-into-one.title: Concatenate Three PDFs into a Single Document
concatenate-three-pdfs-into-one.description: Demonstrates how to merge three PDF files into one using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor and the three‑argument Concatenate method, employing a temporary file for the intermediate result.

merge-multiple-pdf-streams.title: Merge Multiple PDF Streams into a Single PDF
merge-multiple-pdf-streams.description: Demonstrates how to concatenate several PDF streams into one output stream using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.

concatenate-two-pdfs-using-pdffileeditor.title: Concatenate Two PDFs Using PdfFileEditor
concatenate-two-pdfs-using-pdffileeditor.description: Shows how to merge two PDF files into a single document using the two‑file overload of PdfFileEditor.Concatenate, creating sample PDFs on the fly.

concatenate-pdfs-from-memory-streams.title: Concatenate PDFs from Memory Streams to File
concatenate-pdfs-from-memory-streams.description: Creates PDF documents in memory, concatenates them using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor, and writes the merged result directly to a file without intermediate storage.

batch-concatenate-pdfs.title: Batch Concatenate PDFs in a Folder
batch-concatenate-pdfs.description: Shows how to gather all PDF files from a directory and merge them into a single PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

concatenate-multiple-pdfs-measure-time.title: Concatenate Multiple PDFs and Measure Execution Time
concatenate-multiple-pdfs-measure-time.description: Demonstrates how to concatenate fifty small PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor stream overloads, configure automatic stream closing, and measure the operation duration with Stopwatch.

compare-pdf-concatenation-paths-streams.title: Compare PDF Concatenation via File Paths and Streams
compare-pdf-concatenation-paths-streams.description: Demonstrates how to concatenate two PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor with both file‑path and stream overloads, while measuring memory consumption for each approach.

create-pdf-booklet.title: Create Booklet PDF with Aspose.Pdf
create-pdf-booklet.description: Shows how to generate a booklet PDF from an existing file using PdfFileEditor.MakeBooklet with default settings.

create-a5-booklet-from-pdf.title: Create A5 Booklet from PDF
create-a5-booklet-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet with A5 page size from an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor.MakeBooklet overload.

create-booklet-with-custom-page-order.title: Create Booklet PDF with Custom Left/Right Page Order
create-booklet-with-custom-page-order.description: Shows how to generate a booklet PDF using Aspose.Pdf by providing separate left‑hand (odd) and right‑hand (even) page sequences.

create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-size.title: Create Booklet PDF with Custom Page Size
create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-size.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet from an existing PDF while specifying a custom page dimension (A5) using Aspose.Pdf's Facade API.

create-pdf-booklet-in-separate-folders.title: Create PDF Booklets in Separate Output Folders
create-pdf-booklet-in-separate-folders.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet PDF from each source file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and store the result in its own output directory.

delete-pages-and-create-booklet.title: Delete Pages and Create Booklet from PDF
delete-pages-and-create-booklet.description: Shows how to remove specific pages from a PDF and then generate a booklet using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor.

delete-pages-concatenate-pdfs.title: Delete Pages and Concatenate PDFs
delete-pages-concatenate-pdfs.description: Shows how to remove selected pages from a PDF and then merge the resulting document with another PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.

delete-specific-pages-pdf-error-handling.title: Delete Specific Pages from PDF with Error Handling
delete-specific-pages-pdf-error-handling.description: Demonstrates how to remove selected pages from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor Delete method while handling missing input files and PDF‑related exceptions.

create-pdf-booklet-with-audit-log.title: Create PDF Booklet with Audit Log
create-pdf-booklet-with-audit-log.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor while logging each step and the conversion log to a text file for audit purposes.

create-booklet-custom-page-order.title: Create Booklet with Custom Left/Right Page Order
create-booklet-custom-page-order.description: Demonstrates adding visible page numbers, defining custom left and right page arrays, and using Aspose.Pdf's MakeBooklet to generate a booklet with the specified order, then verifies the result by extracting the page numbers.

resize-pdf-to-letter-size.title: Resize PDF to Letter Size Using PdfFileEditor
resize-pdf-to-letter-size.description: Demonstrates how to resize all pages of an existing PDF to US Letter dimensions (8.5" x 11") using the file‑path overload of PdfFileEditor.ResizeContents and save the result.

resize-pdf-pages-to-8-5x11-using-stream.title: Resize PDF Pages to 8.5x11 Inches Using Stream Overload
resize-pdf-pages-to-8-5x11-using-stream.description: Demonstrates how to change all pages of a PDF to standard US Letter size (8.5×11 inches) by using PdfFileEditor’s stream-based ResizeContents method with custom page dimensions.

batch-resize-pdfs-to-a4.title: Batch Resize PDFs to A4
batch-resize-pdfs-to-a4.description: Iterates through all PDF files in a source folder, resizes each document to A4 page size using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, and saves the results to a target directory.

measure-pdf-resize-performance-path-vs-s.title: Measure PDF Resize Performance: Path vs Stream Overloads
measure-pdf-resize-performance-path-vs-s.description: The example resizes all pages of a large PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor and measures the execution time of the file‑path and stream overloads to compare their performance.

create-2up-pdf-layout.title: Create 2-up PDF Layout with Aspose PdfFileEditor
create-2up-pdf-layout.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor to combine two PDF pages onto a single page (2‑up) and save the result.

create-4up-pdf-with-pdffileeditor.title: Create 4‑up PDF using PdfFileEditor and MemoryStream
create-4up-pdf-with-pdffileeditor.description: Demonstrates how to apply a 4‑up (2×2) layout to an existing PDF by using the PdfFileEditor.TryMakeNUp overload that works with streams, keeping the result in memory before optionally saving it to disk.

batch-create-nup-pdfs-3x2.title: Batch Create N‑up PDFs with 3 Columns and 2 Rows
batch-create-nup-pdfs-3x2.description: Shows how to iterate over a list of PDF files and generate N‑up versions using a 3‑column by 2‑row layout with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

nup-to-booklet-pdf.title: Create N‑up PDF and Convert to Booklet
nup-to-booklet-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate an N‑up layout (multiple original pages per sheet) using PdfFileEditor.MakeNUp and then transform the resulting PDF into a booklet with PdfFileEditor.MakeBooklet, including cleanup of the intermediate file.

delete-pages-resize-pdf.title: Delete Pages and Resize PDF Content
delete-pages-resize-pdf.description: Shows how to remove specific pages from a PDF stream using PdfFileEditor and then scale the remaining pages before saving the document.

remove-pages-from-multiple-pdfs-in-paral.title: Remove Pages from Multiple PDFs in Parallel
remove-pages-from-multiple-pdfs-in-paral.description: Demonstrates how to delete specified pages from a list of PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor and process the files concurrently with Parallel.ForEach.

concatenate-pdfs-using-stream-overloads.title: Concatenate PDFs Using Stream Overloads
concatenate-pdfs-using-stream-overloads.description: Shows how to merge multiple PDF files passed as command‑line arguments into a single PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades PdfFileEditor with its stream‑based Concatenate overload.

pdffileeditor-delete-invalid-page-test.title: Test Delete Throws Exception for Invalid Page Number
pdffileeditor-delete-invalid-page-test.description: Shows how to write a unit test that verifies PdfFileEditor.Delete throws an exception when a page number larger than the document length is supplied.

create-booklet-pdf.title: Create Booklet PDF from Stream
create-booklet-pdf.description: Shows how to convert an input PDF stream into a booklet PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor and return the result as a MemoryStream.

create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-order.title: Create Booklet PDF with Custom Page Order
create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-order.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet PDF by specifying left‑hand and right‑hand page sequences using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.

create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-size__v2.title: Create Booklet PDF with Custom 5.5x8.5 Inch Page Size
create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-size__v2.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet from an existing PDF stream using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, specifying a custom 5.5 × 8.5 inch page size, and saving the result to disk.

validate-pdf-concatenation-page-order.title: Validate PDF Concatenation Preserves Page Order
validate-pdf-concatenation-page-order.description: Shows how to concatenate two PDFs with Aspose.Pdf and verify that the merged document keeps the original page sequence by comparing extracted page text.

delete-specific-pages-from-pdfs.title: Delete Specific Pages from PDFs in a Folder
delete-specific-pages-from-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to batch‑process PDF files by removing pages 3 and 4 from each document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades. The example reads PDFs from a source directory and writes the modified files to an output directory.

concatenate-multiple-pdfs-with-logging.title: Concatenate Multiple PDFs with Logging
concatenate-multiple-pdfs-with-logging.description: Demonstrates how to merge several PDF files into a single document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor while logging the input and output file names.

create-booklet-pdf-left-odd-pages.title: Create Booklet PDF with Left Pages as Odd Numbers
create-booklet-pdf-left-odd-pages.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.MakeBooklet to generate a booklet PDF from input streams while defining odd-numbered left pages and even-numbered right pages.

resize-pdf-streams-verify-tiff.title: Resize PDF to Custom Dimensions Using Streams and Verify with TIFF Preview
resize-pdf-streams-verify-tiff.description: Demonstrates how to resize all pages of a PDF to 1024x768 points using the PdfFileEditor stream overload, then creates a TIFF preview of the first page to confirm visual fidelity.

batch-delete-pages-merge-pdfs.title: Batch Delete Pages and Merge PDFs
batch-delete-pages-merge-pdfs.description: Shows how to remove specific pages from multiple PDF files and then concatenate the cleaned PDFs into a single document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

concatenate-multiple-pdfs.title: Concatenate Multiple PDFs
concatenate-multiple-pdfs.description: Shows how to merge several PDF files into a single document using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor facade.

merge-pdfs-from-network-streams.title: Merge PDFs from Network Streams without Intermediate Files
merge-pdfs-from-network-streams.description: Shows how to download PDF files via HttpClient into memory streams and merge them into a single PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor without creating temporary files on disk.

validate-makebooklet-null-pagesize.title: Validate MakeBooklet Throws Exception for Null PageSize
validate-makebooklet-null-pagesize.description: Shows how to test that PdfFileEditor.MakeBooklet raises an ArgumentNullException when the PageSize parameter is null.

delete-pdf-pages-get-size.title: Delete PDF Pages and Get Resulting Size
delete-pdf-pages-get-size.description: Demonstrates how to remove specific pages from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor and return the size of the modified document.

concatenate-pdfs-with-blank-pages.title: Concatenate PDFs with Blank Pages
concatenate-pdfs-with-blank-pages.description: Shows how to merge multiple PDF files and automatically insert a blank page between each document using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-resize-pdfs-to-a5-and-create-bookl.title: Batch Resize PDFs to A5 and Create Booklets
batch-resize-pdfs-to-a5-and-create-bookl.description: Processes each PDF in a folder, resizes its pages to A5 dimensions, and then generates a booklet PDF from the resized file.

delete-pages-create-2up-pdf.title: Delete Pages and Create 2‑up PDF Layout
delete-pages-create-2up-pdf.description: Shows how to remove specified pages from a PDF stream and then arrange the remaining pages in a 2‑up (two pages per sheet) layout, outputting the result to another stream.

create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-order__v2.title: Create Booklet PDF with Custom Page Order
create-booklet-pdf-custom-page-order__v2.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades by specifying left and right page sequences.

concatenate-pdfs-preserve-metadata.title: Concatenate PDFs While Preserving Original Metadata
concatenate-pdfs-preserve-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to merge multiple PDF files using PdfFileEditor and then copy the author, title, and other metadata from the first document to the merged result.

create-booklet-pdf-delete-resize.title: Create Booklet PDF After Deleting and Resizing Pages
create-booklet-pdf-delete-resize.description: Shows how to remove selected pages, resize all page contents, and generate a booklet version of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

create-verify-pdf-booklet-page-sizes.title: Create and Verify PDF Booklet with Various Page Sizes
create-verify-pdf-booklet-page-sizes.description: Demonstrates generating sample PDFs, concatenating them, and using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor to create a booklet while reporting different page size configurations.

concatenate-pdfs-in-zip.title: Concatenate PDFs Inside a Zip Archive
concatenate-pdfs-in-zip.description: Shows how to read PDF files from a zip archive, merge them with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor, and write the merged PDF back into the same archive.

delete-pdf-pages-cli.title: Delete Pages from PDF via Command Line
delete-pdf-pages-cli.description: Shows how to build a command‑line tool that removes specified pages from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor and writes the output file.

parallel-pdf-page-deletion.title: Parallel Deletion of PDF Pages
parallel-pdf-page-deletion.description: Shows how to delete specific pages from multiple PDF documents concurrently using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor with Parallel.ForEach.

resize-pdf-landscape-booklet.title: Resize PDF to Landscape and Create Booklet
resize-pdf-landscape-booklet.description: Shows how to change a PDF's page orientation to landscape using PdfPageEditor and then generate a booklet from the resized document with PdfFileEditor.

test-pdffileeditor-concatenate-empty-str.title: Unit Test for PdfFileEditor Concatenate with Empty Streams
test-pdffileeditor-concatenate-empty-str.description: Shows how to write an NUnit unit test that verifies PdfFileEditor.Concatenate throws an ArgumentException when the input stream array is empty.

concatenate-multiple-pdfs__v2.title: Concatenate Multiple PDFs Using Aspose.Pdf
concatenate-multiple-pdfs__v2.description: Demonstrates reading PDF files as streams, merging them with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor, and saving the combined document to disk.

audit-log-pdf-page-deletion.title: Audit Log for PDF Page Deletion
audit-log-pdf-page-deletion.description: Demonstrates how to delete specific pages from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's facade API and log the number of pages actually removed for audit purposes.

resize-pdfs-create-booklet.title: Resize PDFs and Create a Booklet
resize-pdfs-create-booklet.description: Shows how to resize multiple PDF files to 1024x768 points, concatenate them, and generate a booklet PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

delete-pages-from-pdfs.title: Delete Specific Pages from PDFs
delete-pages-from-pdfs.description: Shows how to remove given page numbers from one or more PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and save the cleaned versions.

merge-pdfs-with-blank-separator-pages.title: Merge PDFs with Blank Separator Pages
merge-pdfs-with-blank-separator-pages.description: Shows how to concatenate several PDF files and insert a blank page between each document using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-and-concatenate-pdfs.title: Resize Multiple PDFs and Concatenate into One Document
resize-and-concatenate-pdfs.description: Shows how to batch‑resize PDF pages to 1024×768 points using PdfFileEditor.ResizeContents and then merge the resized PDFs into a single file with PdfFileEditor.Concatenate.

delete-and-resize-pdf-pages.title: Delete and Resize PDF Pages
delete-and-resize-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to delete selected pages from a PDF, resize the remaining pages, and return the processed document as a MemoryStream using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

concatenate-pdfs-add-page-numbers.title: Concatenate PDFs and Add Page Numbers
concatenate-pdfs-add-page-numbers.description: Shows how to merge multiple PDF files into a single document and automatically insert page numbers using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

create-left-half-booklet.title: Create Left-Half Booklet from PDF
create-left-half-booklet.description: Shows how to generate a booklet PDF using only the even-numbered (left) pages from the first half of a source PDF by leveraging Aspose.Pdf's Document and PdfFileEditor classes.

create-booklet-from-second-half.title: Create Booklet from Second Half of PDF
create-booklet-from-second-half.description: Demonstrates how to generate a booklet PDF where the left pages come from the first half of a source document and the right pages come from the second half, using Aspose.Pdf's MakeBooklet method.
